title: Millennium Falcon
subtitle: Piece of Junk
text:
This unit enters play ready.

When you ready cards during the regroup phase: Either pay [1 resource] or return this unit to her owner's hand.
rules:
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
You may choose whether to pay 1 or return the Millennium Falcon to its owner’s hand.
